title: EXPLORING PERSONA-DEPENDENT LLM ALIGNMENT FOR THE MORAL MACHINE EXPERIMENT
findings: Human moral preferences in the scenarios were consistent between religious and non-religious groups. In contrast, LLMs showed more variability, with some models like GPT-3.5 and Llama2 making moral decisions that opposed the human consensus when a religious or non-religious persona was assigned. Llama2 also exhibited a very low valid response rate (refusing to answer) when assigned a 'religious' persona (6.0%).
